title: ever BAYLOR|A-Line V-Neck Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening wear with this stunning Short Sleeve V-Neck Asymmetrical Hem Sequin Formal Evening Dress! The shimmering paillette embellishments catch the light with every move, creating a dazzling effect perfect for any special occasion. The flattering V-neckline highlights your collarbone while the short sleeves add a touch of elegance. The asymmetrical hemline adds a modern twist, making this dress both chic and unique. Ideal for formal events, weddings, or cocktail parties, this dress ensures you will be the center of attention wherever you go!


Fit: Please refer to the size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises sequin&polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch
